what_worked.description: Ghost mannequin setup eliminates human skin distraction when cataloging intricate embroidery and zari pinstripes
Macro quadrants (neckline, waistband, cowl droplets, dori tassels) provide downstream inpainters with ultra-high-resolution texture references

what_failed.failure_mode: Split view bleeding neckline gold thread into background
what_failed.root_cause: High-contrast border between garment and pure white/neutral background losing sharpness

what_to_adapt.rule_addition: Enforce razor-sharp seam boundaries, edge contrast, and anti-bleed protocols
